MURDEROUS GUNMAN
CR 10

XP 9,600
Human soldier (gunner) 10
CN Medium humanoid (human)
Init +5; Senses Perception +14

DEFENSE

AC 23, touch 15, flat-footed 19 (+4 Dex, +1 deflection, +8 armor); +3 vs. firearms
hp 89 (10d10+20+10)
Fort +9, Ref +8, Will +8

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft. (40 ft. out of armor)
Melee masterwork dagger +12/+7 (1d4+1 P or S, 19–20/×2) or unarmed strike +11/+6 (1d3+1 B; +10 bonus damage on a critical hit)
Ranged semi-automatic pistol +16/+11 (1d8+2 B&P, 19–20/×4, range incr. 25 ft. [10 ft. with suppressor], semi-automatic, AP 5 CW) or semi-automatic rifle +16/+11 (1d10+2 B&P, 19–20/×4, range incr. 90 ft., semi-automatic, CW) or rocket launcher +15 (6d6 B plus 6d6 fire, range incr. 120 ft.; slow-firing)
Special Attacks valor abilities (shooter’s valor +1d6)

STATISTICS

Str 13 (+1), Dex 20 (+5), Con 14 (+2), Int 12 (+1), Wis 12 (+1), Cha 8 (–1)
Base Atk +10; CMB +11; CMD 26
Feats Deadly Aim, Exotic Weapon Proficiency (heavy weaponry), Improved Critical (semi-automatic pistol), Improved Critical (semi-automatic rifle), Improved Initiative (B), Point-Blank Master, Point-Blank Shot, Precise Shot, Rapid Shot, Unarmed Strike (B), Weapon Focus (semi-automatic pistol), Weapon Focus (semi-automatic rifle) (B), Weapon Specialization (semi-automatic pistol), Weapon Specialization (semi-automatic rifle)
Skills Acrobatics +16, Climb +12, Disable Device +16, Heal +14, Perception +14, Survival +14
Languages Common, Orc
SQ fighter training, gear boosts (gear feat [Weapon Focus], unarmed mauler), primary fighting style (sharpshooter), primary fighting style techniques (sniper’s aim, focus fire, intense fire), secondary fighting style (blitz), secondary fighting style techniques (rapid response), valor (max. 2 points)
Gear 3 adamantine pellet grenades, potion of cure moderate wounds, rocket launcher (single-use); Other Gear +3 ballistic armor, semi-automatic pistol with a suppressor (“silencer”) and 3 clips (20 bullets each), semi-automatic rifle with 3 clips (20 bullets each), masterwork dagger, masterwork thieves’ tools, boots of the cat, ring of protection +1, 100 gp
